baseline_diagnostics.kind: deterministic dataset diagnostics; no learned model, GPU execution, or optimizer updates
baseline_diagnostics.scope_limit: The correction-only-plus-query rule assumes opposite final entity bits and can solve the paired task without retaining initial assignments. It is not a valid general binding oracle.

configuration.loss: mean full-vocabulary cross entropy at final answer position only
configuration.reset: all states zero independently for every prompt

dataset.balance: exact corrected-entity x final-a-bit strata within each split; paired queries have opposite answers; initial assignment order and distractor gaps random
dataset.grammar: two assignments; 2..12 xyz distractors; one opposite-value correction; remaining xyz distractors; each history paired with ?a= and ?b=; opposite final entity values
dataset.hash_encoding: SHA256 over each ordered ASCII prompt + TAB + answer + LF; combined hash over train hash + LF + test hash + LF
dataset.scope_limit: opposite final bits imply equal initial bits; a correction-plus-query rule can solve this task without retaining both initial assignments
dataset.source: Rust deterministic synthetic diagnostic; no FineWeb or language-checkpoint updates
dataset.split: 512 unique training-prefix groups and 128 unique test-prefix groups; two opposite-answer queries per group produce 1024/256 cases; reject duplicate histories globally before assigning split

device_identity: Some(DeviceIdentity { name: "AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT", fingerprint: "spirv_4098_30096", physical: Some(PhysicalDevice { pci_address: None, luid: None, registry_entry_id: None, vendor: Some(Amd) }) })

minibatch_schedule.hash_encoding: SHA256 over flattened indices as little-endian u64
minibatch_schedule.sampling: uniform training-case indices with replacement; reused identically across all modes and model seeds

protocol.accuracy: argmax over the entire character vocabulary; binary forced-choice accuracy is secondary
protocol.criterion: Both mean accuracy >= best other retrained mode + 0.05; positive paired accuracy difference for at least 2/3 default seeds; lower paired mean answer NLL
protocol.matched_controls: all modes clone identical initial parameters per seed; same batches, tensor operations, parameter count, update count, optimizer, and token budget; only interface gates differ
protocol.shuffled_spike_feedback_control: not implemented; no claim about resistance to shuffled feedback
protocol.timing: forward evaluation includes host input transfers and synchronized final-logit readbacks; excludes queued parameter updates; no real-time claim

scope: Focused synthetic mechanism test; not natural-language, emotional, or symbolic reasoning validation
